name: plugin-workbench
description: A plugin's real cost is invisible until installed, and authoring one means guessing at unwritten standards, so make, measure, and fix plugins around one six-dimension rubric: scaffold and author against it, score any plugin into an HTML scorecard with an adopt or rework verdict, apply the fixes ranked by the point delta a script computes, read back what each plugin put in a session's context, and reinstall a marketplace checkout from the working tree.
